title: Can't see raw data during warmup G6
body: I used to always have raw data visible in xDrip, Nightscout and watch faces with the G4. But now using the G6 and July 6 version of xDrip, we see no raw data during warmup. And once working, we see no raw data in the Nightscout UI, but do see raw data in the xDrip app.
